call.title: Handbook review — 2026-11-09
call.content:
Handbook review — 2026-11-09
4 documents read: 1 contradiction, 1 out of date, 2 not covered

## Contradictions
- Notice period — "Policy — Leaving" §2: "One month's notice for all staff" vs "Policy — Contracts" §5: "Three months' notice for senior staff".

## Out of date
- "Policy — Leave" §4 names "The 2024 holiday year"; the current year is not stated.

## Not covered
- "Can I carry leave over?" — closest: "Policy — Leave" §4, which gives the year but no carry-over rule.
- "Who pays for a home desk?" — nothing; "Policy — Remote" has no equipment line.

## Fixes
- "Policy — Leaving" §2: "Notice is one month, or three months for senior staff as their contract states." (keeps the later Contracts document's rule and says so)
- "Policy — Leave" §4: state the current holiday year.
- "Policy — Leave" §4: add a carry-over rule — the owner to choose the figure.
- "Policy — Remote": add an equipment line — who pays, up to what amount, what is returned.
